title: Guest Post Pitch Tear Down: Avoid These 11 Mistakes Like the Plague
summary: A real guest post pitch received at the agency gets a full tear-down. Eleven specific mistakes are highlighted — the kind that get pitches ignored or rejected immediately.
show_notes_text:
### Guest Post Pitch Tear Down: 11 Mistakes to Avoid

We picked up a real guest post pitch we received and walked through a full teardown, highlighting 11 specific mistakes.

If you're doing any kind of outreach — whether guest posts, link building, or PR — this episode will show you exactly what NOT to do, and why these mistakes result in instant rejection.
